decision_rule: Exhaust free, reproducible sources before buying data. Paid data is allowed only for a field that remains materially unavailable or too stale for weekly use.

sources.name: nflverse / nflreadr
limitations: Participation/route data from 2023 onward is not updated during the season; it is supplied after the postseason.
The nflverse injury source died after 2024; current 2025+ injury data is not presently available from this feed.

sources.name: Fantasy Life Utilization Report
limitations: Need to validate stable machine-readable extraction/export method and terms before automating ingestion.

sources.name: StatRankings
limitations: Best treated as a cross-check unless stable automated extraction is confirmed.

sources.name: NFL Savant
limitations: Coverage and extraction method still require direct validation before model use.

sources.name: PFF public weekly usage reports
limitations: Not suitable as the primary automated feed; use for spot checks and manual verification.

remaining_step_1_gaps: Find and validate a free current injury/practice-status source for 2026.
Validate reproducible extraction for Fantasy Life weekly utilization data.
Validate reproducible extraction for StatRankings route participation.
Validate NFL Savant coverage and update cadence.
Define fallback hierarchy when a free source is stale or unavailable.
Only price paid alternatives if one of these gaps remains material after validation.
